paper_metadata.title: Machine learning assisted design of novel refractory high entropy alloys with enhanced mechanical properties

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: This paper details an alloy design effort by machine learning (ML) attempting to design novel refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs) with exceptional mechanical properties at elevated temperatures and good room temperature ductility.
